SPECIAL ABILITIES

Courageous

This NPC gains a +2 trait bonus on saving throws against fear effects.

Northern Ancestry

This NPC gains a +1 trait bonus on Fortitude saves, as well as cold resistance 2; this resistance does not stack with cold resistance gained from any other source.

ABOUT

With a combination of long raven hair bound in three crimson silk-wrapped braids, striking ice-blue eyes, and a statuesque height of five feet, ten inches, This NPC makes for a commanding figure on either the battlefield or in a grange hall. Knowing that first impressions last, she takes care to polish her chain shirt and keep her greataxe sharp—but her tongue bears the keenest edge. On the backs of her hands she bears the marks of her training: intricate runic tattoos said to induce fear in her foes and strength in her sword-arm.
